input.quote: shall be governed by the internal laws of the State of Wisconsin, excluding its principles of conflict of laws.
input.rationale: Section 22.1 selects Wisconsin law and Section 22.2 fixes exclusive venue in Milwaukee County and the Eastern District of Wisconsin — M&I's home jurisdiction and outside the accepted list of New York, Delaware, California, or England and Wales, so the clause fails both the preferred and fallback positions. Article 15 contains only an escalation process and no arbitration agreement (the references to arbitration in 22.2 and 22.11 are enforcement/fee mechanics only), so there is no foreign arbitration overlay. We move to the preferred New York position with exclusive New York County merits jurisdiction, preserving the remainder of both sentences including the judgment-enforcement consent.

mappings.element: New York law governs the Agreement.
State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits, subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere.

proposal.summary: Move governing law to New York and exclusive merits venue to New York County courts.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We moved governing law and venue to our accepted New York position, replacing Wisconsin law and the exclusive Milwaukee County / Eastern District of Wisconsin forum. We can accept Delaware, California, or England and Wales (with London courts) as a fallback.

ops.oldText: venue in an exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Milwaukee County, Wisconsin and the Federal District Court for the Eastern District of Wisconsin
ops.newText: venue in the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, New York for the merits, subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere
